title: 5F1 · eyelet board layout
scopeNotes: Illustrative geometry follows the existing layout; it is not dimensioned chassis or manufacturing data.
Connections identify layout endpoints, not simulated current flow or complete DC net membership.
The input jacks retain the existing linked-input simplification; C2 and C4 are in the BOM but not placed in this layout.
6.3 V heater wiring is not shown while the source layout's heater connections are being corrected; the pilot lamp is shown as hardware only.
The separate 5 V rectifier filament routes remain shown within the existing drawing's annotation scope.

connectivity.note: Crossing paths do not imply a junction. Shared eyelets have identical coordinates; component leads are not shorted together.

components.label: Output trans
components.role: Single-ended output (impedance not marked on the drawing; typical SE 6V6 load)

omittedConnections.reason: 6.3 V heater wiring is omitted while the source layout's heater connections are being corrected. The 12AX7 needs joined pins 4/5 against pin 9; the current pair expansion omits pin 9.
